mapper.select: select sys_id , table_name , table_num , table_qty , x_coordinate , y_coordinate , height , width , table_type , object_type from table_info si where 1=1 and ( si.object_type in ('02', '03') or exists ( select 1 from qr_code qc where 1=1 and qc.link_sys_id = si.sys_id ) ) and si.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and delete_yn = 'N' and use_yn = 'Y' order by table_num asc

update.foreach: insert into table_info ( sys_id , table_num , table_qty , use_yn , delete_yn , table_name , x_coordinate , y_coordinate , height , width , table_type , object_type , insert_datetime , insert_user_id , sys_plant_cd ) values ( #{item.sysId}, #{item.tableNum}, #{item.tableQty}, 'Y', 'N', #{item.tableName}, #{item.xCoordinate}, #{item.yCoordinate}, #{item.height}, #{item.width}, #{item.tableType}, #{item.objectType}, now(), #{userId}, #{sysPlantCd} )

update table_info set x_coordinate = #{item.xCoordinate}, y_coordinate = #{item.yCoordinate}, height = #{item.height}, width = #{item.width}, table_type = #{item.tableType}, object_type = #{item.objectType}, modify_datetime = now(), modify_user_id = #{userId} where 1=1 and sys_id = #{item.sysId}

update table_info set x_coordinate = null, y_coordinate = null, height = null, width = null, table_type = #{item.tableType}, object_type = #{item.objectType}, modify_datetime = now(), modify_user_id = #{userId} where 1=1 and sys_id = #{item.sysId}

mapper.select: select sys_id , table_name , table_num , table_qty , x_coordinate , y_coordinate , height , width , table_type , object_type from table_info si where 1=1 and exists ( select 1 from qr_code qc where 1=1 and qc.link_sys_id = si.sys_id ) and si.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and delete_yn = 'N' and use_yn = 'Y' order by table_num asc
